meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 接到 git 请求会先判断是提交、变基还是查历史,再把改动按目录和关注点拆成多个原子提交;提交前会先输出仓库的提交风格检测结果和提交计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等关键词,或要求找出某次改动是哪个提交引入的、由谁写的时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动提交,按目录拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 先输出风格检测和提交计划,再逐个提交

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个
这行代码是谁写的?哪个提交加的?
say.note: 用 blame 和 log -S 查历史

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude classifies git requests as commit, rebase, or history search, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits by directory and concern. Before committing it prints the repo's commit style and a commit plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "commit", "rebase", "squash" and similar keywords, or ask which commit introduced a change or who wrote it.

say_en.text: Commit these changes as multiple atomic commits, grouped by directory.
say_en.note: Prints style detection and commit plan first.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one with an interactive rebase.
say_en.note: Runs a rebase to rewrite history.

say_en.text: Who wrote this line, and which commit added it?
